//scripts: Bare binary names (tsc, webflow, concurrently) DO NOT WORK here: this
project's path contains an '&', which truncates npm's Windows shims and
fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Every script calls node with an explicit
path, matching the other three packages in this repo.
The Webflow CLI is not a dependency of this package — it already lives in
webflow-components/, so it is referenced there rather than installed twice.
generate runs before every build so src/pages-data.ts cannot drift from
scripts.dev: npm run generate && npm run compile && npm run serve
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run compile && node ../webflow-components/node_modules/@webflow/webflow-cli/dist/index.js extension bundle
